name: SSTV (slow-scan TV)
description: Slow-scan TV inside Kainos: receive Martin, Scottie, Robot 36 and PD pictures (found automatically, slant-corrected, with the sender's callsign and a gallery), and send them: a one-time station setup makes your CQ, Reply and 73 pictures, and Reply answers in the sender's mode.
author: Justin Cron K7JUS
